chunks: Al-Qasim from Ali from Abu Basir who said:

Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him) said: 'Verily, the light will be divided among the people on the Day of Judgment in accordance with their faith. The share of the hypocrite will be such that his light will extend only to the tip of his left toe, then it will be extinguished, and he will say,

Yes, but your own selves led you to temptation, so you awaited [our demise] and doubted, and false hopes deluded you until Allah's decree came to pass. And the Deceiver deluded you about Allah. So today no ransom will be taken from you, nor from the disbelievers. Your home is the Fire; that is your guardian, and evil is the destination.
Then he said: 'O Abu Muhammad, by Allah, this is not what Allah said to the Jews and Christians, but He meant the people of the Qiblah.'

key_terms.الْغُرُورُ: The Deceiver (God or Satan depending on context, here likely God's decree or Satan)

ai.seo_question: How is light distributed among hypocrites on the Day of Judgment according to Shia hadith?
ai.summary: This hadith from *Kitab al-Zuhd* elucidates the concept of *Nur* (light) as a tangible reward for faith, highlighting the fragility of hypocrites (*Munafiqun*) within the Muslim community who receive minimal light that is easily extinguished. The Imam clarifies that the Quranic dialogue regarding the 'people of the Qiblah' refers specifically to Muslims who appear righteous but lack deep conviction, distinguishing them from Jews and Christians. This underscores the Shia emphasis on inner sincerity (*Ikhlas*) over outward ritual observance in the context of the Day of Judgment.

en.shaykh-tahir-ridha-jaffer: 8.Al-Qāsim narrated from ʿAlī, from Abū Baṣīr who said, “Abū ʿAbdillāh (a) said, ‘Verily the light on the Day of Judgment will be divided among the people in accordance to the extent of their belief. The share of the hypocrite will be such that his light will only extend to the tip of his left toe, then when it is extinguished, he will say [to the believer], “Stay where you are so that I can take from some of your light.” [But] it will be said, “Go back and seek a light [there],” (Q57:13) meaning where the light was [first] distributed. So they will [try to] return but a separating wall will be erected [to block them]. They will thus call out to them from behind the wall, “Were we not with you [in the world]?” They will reply, “Yes [you were], but you allowed yourselves to be tempted, awaited [our demise], doubted [the truth], and were deluded by false hopes until Allah’s decree came to pass. Hence the Deceiver deceived you about Allah. So today no ransom will be accepted from you [hypocrites], nor from the disbelievers. Your home is the Fire – that is where you belong. What an evil destination!” (Q57:14-15).’ Then he said, ‘O Abā Muḥammad,[1] by Allah this was not said to the Jews or the Christians; rather, it refers to the people of the Qiblah (i.e. those who outwardly profess Islam).’”
